description: Remove Negative Energy | Santoor & 528Hz | 1.5 Hours of bright Indian classical santoor to clear heavy energy and start your day light.

Some mornings you wake up already carrying weight. Ninety minutes of shimmering hammered santoor in Raga Bilawal, tuned to a warm 528Hz, to help the heaviness lift and your energy reset before the day begins.
🎧 HOW TO USE — play softly as you wake, stretch, or sit quietly. Bright but never jarring.
⏱ BEST FOR — clearing negative energy · morning energy reset · aura cleansing · a light, positive start
🎵 ABOUT — Raga Bilawal is the clear, open morning raga of Indian classical music; the santoor's hundred strings have long been the sound of lightness.
